title: Stepper Behavior
description: x-stepper builds a number field with − and + buttons that change the value by step, never going below min or above max.

min.description: Lowest value − can reach. Absent: no lower bound.

max.description: Highest value + can reach. Absent: no upper bound.

step.description: How much one − or + click changes the value.

value.description: Starting value. On a <div> host, a number written between the tags wins over this; on an <input> host, the input's own value is used when this is absent.

wbBehavior.name: stepper
wbBehavior.description: Adds increment/decrement controls to numeric inputs.

$view.name: dec
$view.description: The − button (aria-label Decrease). Lowers the value by step, never below min.

$view.name: value
$view.description: Shows the current value inside a <div x-stepper>. An <input x-stepper> holds the value itself instead: it is wrapped in a .x-stepper div between the two buttons and gets x-stepper__input.

$view.name: inc
$view.description: The + button (aria-label Increase). Raises the value by step, never above max.

events.wb:stepper:change: Fired by stepper() on the host after − or + changes the value; detail.value is the new value.
